item.title: Version 1.8.0
item.description:
Version 1.8.0

A quieter window, and a tour

The monitor's toolbar was eleven controls fighting for one row. This release calms the window down, gives every sheet and panel the same chrome, and brings back a proper What's New tour.

A calmer toolbar
  • One button runs the session — Start and Stop are the same control now, because only one of them is ever available. Return still starts it.
  • The rest moved into a menu — Reset session, the cache release test, past sessions and Settings live behind ⋯, leaving Marker and Export where your hand expects them.
  • Status reads in one line — The screen under test, the last update and the Live pill now sit on one strip beside the app name instead of three ragged lines.
Every window is ours
  • Close, minimise and zoom, drawn by the app — The window buttons match the rest of the app and still do exactly what they always did.
  • One shell for every sheet — Past sessions, the AI report, the cache release test and the pickers share a header, a close button and a footer, so they stop drifting apart.
  • Save panels say what they are saving — Exporting tells you how many readings of which app are about to be written, without replacing Finder's own panel.
The tour is back
  • What's New, rebuilt — A paged tour with a colour per section, built from this changelog, shown once after an update and reopenable from the app menu.
  • Demo mode for a devices-free look — Launch with DPM_DEMO=dashboard and the charts fill with a realistic session, so the window can be shown without hardware attached.
